children: Taiwan's central bank is likely to raise the policy rate in September, according to BofA Securities in a research note. "Currency appreciation is unlikely to substitute for a hike in the near term, as the New Taiwan dollar remains weaker than a year ago and any pass-through to inflation would take time," the bank says. Taiwan's central bank also has limited scope to rely on rapid New Taiwan dollar appreciation. BofA expects Taiwan's central bank to raise its policy rate by 12.5 basis points in September.
